mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_FORMULA_TRACE_TASK SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'executing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as executingTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failedTasks FROM TBL_FORMULA_TRACE_TASK WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{companyId}
